title: Correctable erasure and the count of supportable logical operators
statement:
Let $S$ be an isotropic subspace of the symplectic space $V = \mathbb{F}_p^n \times \mathbb{F}_p^n$ (with $p$ prime), and let $M \subseteq \{0,1,\dots,n-1\}$ be an erasure set that is correctable for $S$. Writing $M^c$ for the complement of $M$, one has
\[
g(S, M^c) \;=\; 2n - 2\dim_{\mathbb{F}_p} S.
\]
hypotheses_covered: p is prime (so F_p is the prime field)
replaced:
If $S$ is isotropic and $M$ is correctable, then
$g(S,M^c) = 2n - 2\dim_{\mathbb{F}_p}(S)$.
